profile.headline: Software Engineer at Quip
profile.summary:
Software engineer working on collaboration at Quip.

I'm especially interested in education, particularly teaching and building educational tools!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Quip's mission is to build a new class of productivity tool that every person at every company enjoys using every single day. We combine documents, spreadsheets, chat, and slides into a powerful collaboration platform that integrates with Salesforce. 

I'm working on making the integration between Quip and Salesforce seamless, and previously I have worked on improving the accessibility of our product. If any of this sounds exciting, we're hiring!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a software engineer on the Search Platform team, I focused on features like autocomplete, trending queries and search guides. I worked on combating sensitive content, expanding search features internationally, and improving search feature quality.

I have also worked our search metrics workflow and dashboard, to give my team more insight into the impact experiments have on users.

Technologies: Java, Python, Scala, Cascading, Scalding, Thrift, Hive, Presto

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Software engineering intern on the web team. Built tags for video, exercise and article pages to increase learner discovery of related materials. Made registration flow and other popular pages on the site responsive to optimize user experience on mobile web.

Technologies: React, Python, jQuery, Jinja, Handlebars.js

positions.title: CS161 Course Assistant
positions.description:
Course assistant for CS 161: Design and Analysis of Algorithms. Held office hours, wrote course notes and problem sets, graded assignments and exams. 

Topics include data structures, algorithm design and analysis.

positions.title: CS106 Section Leader
positions.description:
Led discussion section for the introductory computer science courses, held office hours, and graded assignments and exams.

As Small Group Leader, I trained new section leaders, preparing them for the social and technical challenges of leading a section.

Topics include Java/C++, data abstraction and modularity, testing and debugging techniques.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Software engineering intern on the iOS Google Slides team. Added a native video playback feature to iOS Slides in collaboration with YouTube and Google Drive teams.

Technologies: Objective-C

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Software engineering intern on the iOS Google Wallet team. I worked primarily on building the user interface for the request money feature. Collaborated with product managers and designers to define the request money user experience, and worked with the backend team to outline additions to the API.

Technologies: Objective-C

volunteerExperiences.description: Worked one-on-one with early elementary students to develop their language and literacy skills. I created personalized lesson plans to help students improve their decoding and overall comprehension.
